items.caption: Main diagonal three-quarter medium-full portrait of Tohno Akiha.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a white rectangular box at the top-right corner.
items.text:
每个人都扮演着与自身
身份相符的角色

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a thin white rectangular box on the upper-right.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a white rectangular box in the upper-center.
items.text:
远野家家主的身份，
是由他人赋予的

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a thin white rectangular box near the center.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a white rectangular box in the upper-left.
items.text:
所谓身份，
并不是只能被赋予的，
也可以靠自己获得

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a small white rectangular box on the far upper-left.

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a white rectangular box in the middle-left.
items.text:
我所获得的，
是远野志贵的妹妹
这个身份

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a thin white rectangular box on the middle-left.
items.text: 因为他心里的第一名不存在

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a white rectangular box in the bottom-left.
items.text:
我不奢求太多……
因为即便以这个身份，
我也可以一直一直
待在那个人身边…

items.label: text
items.caption: Clean vertical Chinese narration text in a thin white rectangular box at the far bottom-left corner.
